title: '<entity_id>' in states Is Always False

hard_fail_if: model says 'child in states' is a valid existence check
model's corrected template still uses 'in states' with an entity_id string
soft_fail_if: model replaces the test with has_value() without noting it also rejects unavailable entities
model does not mention the sub-minute now() re-render issue (FG-48)
pass_if: model explains that states iterates state objects, so an entity_id string is never in it and the test is always false
model replaces it with states[child] is not none (existence) or has_value(child) (availability), and says which it chose

notes: From Nyx draft FG-49 (room occupancy bridge, 2026-11-09). The prompt also contains FG-48; a model that spots both scores higher on soft criteria.
